category_edits.rationale: Test a shorter causal pooling half-life of 2.5 interactions across all four datasets while retaining the 0.8/0.2 readout blend, padding exclusion and final-real-position inference. Synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor validation. Prior evidence reports regression for this configuration; this implements the supplied hypothesis without claiming improvement.

response.change_summary: Change only causal pooling half-life from 3 to 2.5 and synchronize metadata with the embedded predictor. Preserve the GRU backbone and one checkpoint per dataset.
